additional_info.subject: Case description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
is it possible to check logs on the charger n. 170002655 on yesterday 27 of October at 8:57:07 p.m. (CU Time); At 11:27:22 p.m. (CU Time) and at 10:16:20 p.m. (CU Time) ?
A customer tried to charge on type2 plug, thru credit card, but each recharge was interrupted automatically.
Thank you in advance.
software version
: v6.0.3-0-g215cb74

additional_info.subject: ID0458287-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002655] CU logs check CRM:03056000343
additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I found the root cause and it's related to a communication problem with the Outlet. This is declared fixed from firmware side on the latest version v8.0.5.
In order to understand if there is an actual problem with the outlet, we need to first install the latest version.
If you do not allow the v8.0.5 to be installed, the best I can do is to ask to update to v7.0.5 where we can apply a specific hotfix for this.
If it's still not allowed to be any kind of update to be performed,
I will wait for your feedback. Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
